title: AI Infra 是否已经进入 Narrative 超前 Reality、但瓶颈与利润池仍在迁移的阶段？
prior_belief: AI infrastructure Reality may still be expanding while the binding bottleneck and profit pool migrate beyond GPU, but market Narrative and valuation may already discount part of that expansion.
defeat_condition: The thesis is defeated if PIT-qualified evidence shows broad hyperscaler capex deceleration without offsetting networking or power constraint migration, or if price and valuation remove right-tail payoff under the stated survival constraints.
next_action: Collect and admit the frozen Priority A Reality metrics under PIT and provenance rules.
